questions.q: Tell me about a design project you worked on from research to final screens. What problem were you solving and what did you deliver?
questions.looks_for: Clear problem, users, their process (research, flows, wireframes, prototypes, testing), tools used, their own contribution, and the outcome after launch.

questions.q: Describe a time user testing or feedback showed that your design was not working. What did you change?
questions.looks_for: Specific feedback, what they learned, how they changed the design, and whether it improved. Shows openness to criticism and focus on users over personal taste.

questions.q: How would you find out why many users drop off on a sign-up screen?
questions.looks_for: Looks at analytics and funnels, session recordings, talks to or tests with users, reviews the form for unnecessary fields, unclear errors or trust issues, then tests a change and measures.

questions.q: How do you design for users in India who may use cheap phones, slow internet, or are not comfortable reading English?
questions.looks_for: Light screens, clear icons with text, simple words, local language support, large touch targets, offline or slow-network states, and testing with real users from that group.

questions.q: Why do teams create a design system, and what problems can come up when maintaining one?
questions.looks_for: Consistency, faster design and development, shared components. Problems: going out of date, too rigid, poor documentation, low adoption. Mentions working with developers to keep it in sync.

questions.q: A product manager insists on adding a big banner that you believe will annoy users and hurt the main task. What do you do?
questions.looks_for: Understands the business goal behind it, shares evidence or user data, proposes alternatives, suggests an A/B test, and accepts the final decision professionally if overruled.

questions.q: Why do you want to work as a UI / UX designer, and what do you want to grow into? Please state clearly your notice period or joining date, and your expected salary in ₹ per month or per year?
questions.looks_for: Gives a genuine reason tied to the work, a sensible growth direction, a clear notice period or joining date, and a clear salary figure or range in ₹. Honest about buyout or negotiable notice if relevant.
